podcast.title: Outlet for Buddy Holly Solo Material (1957)
podcast.body: Coral also became the designated label for Buddy Holly's solo material, allowing him to record new songs under his own name, with the same musicians who played on The Crickets' records, thereby doubling the amount of material they could release. "And at the same time, they also made an agreement that Holly could record solo material for Coral."

podcast.title: Marketing of Johnny Burnette as Solo Artist
podcast.body: Coral Records' decision to release recordings under "Johnny Burnette and the Rock and Roll Trio" instead of just the band name, and later solely under "Johnny Burnette," caused significant friction within the band, leading to its eventual breakup, and also prevented The Burnette Brothers from recording as a duo. "Coral Records decided to release their recordings as by Johnny Burnett and the rock and roll trio, and the other two members were understandably furious."
